note: Defects this layer has actually shipped, or plausible neighbours of them,
written back into the code on purpose. tools/mutate-sql.sh applies each one
to a copy of the tree and requires some check to notice.
Every other tool here answers 'is the code right?'. This answers 'would we
know if it weren't?', which is a different question and the one that was
never asked. The slot invariant added after the code review was a no-op: it
was committed, trusted, and did not fire when the bug it existed for was put
back by hand. Nothing said so, because nothing tried.
`from` must occur exactly once. A pattern that matches nothing is a suite
error, never a pass -- a stale pattern would otherwise be scored by whatever
the checks say about unmutated code, which is this tool's own failure mode.

mutations.name: collation-dropped
mutations.was: M1. MariaDB's REGEXP and = follow the operand's collation, which is case-insensitive by default, so "A" $== "a" was TRUE on the server and FALSE in SEL.

mutations.name: find-args-swapped
mutations.was: The reordering template that made Fragment::bindings() walk the output rather than return the pool.

mutations.name: binary-operand-not-cast
mutations.was: Found by the fuzz lane. HEX(1) hexes the number and answers "1"; SEL's TO_HEX(1) is "31".

mutations.name: pad-truncates-again
mutations.was: Found by the oracle. LPAD('7777', 2, '0') is '77'; SEL's PADL returns "7777".

mutations.name: min-of-one-argument
mutations.was: Found by the oracle. LEAST and GREATEST are variadic but need two arguments; SEL's MIN takes one.

mutations.name: bindings-unwalked
mutations.was: Code review. Returning the pool ignores reordering templates and repeated slots.

mutations.name: number-becomes-a-placeholder
mutations.was: The params-mode defect the fuzz lane found: no coercion of a bound string reproduces a bare decimal literal.

mutations.name: union-instead-of-merge
mutations.was: Code review. PHP's + keeps the LEFT value, so field-name normalisation was discarded and every lookup failed.

mutations.name: concat-treated-as-comparison
mutations.was: Class F. The collation fix keyed on the variant name `text`, which `&` also uses.

mutations.name: define-upper-cases-everything
mutations.was: Code review. Skeleton names are camel-case, so upper-casing every key made runtime skel registration silently dead.

mutations.name: negative-literal-unparenthesised
mutations.was: MariaDB reads -- as double negation and gets the right answer by luck; PostgreSQL and SQLite read it as a comment.

mutations.name: relation-slots-collide
mutations.was: Item 6 absorbed: the three relation skeletons merge two slot maps that were disjoint by inspection and by nothing else.

mutations.name: arity-fallback-ignored
mutations.was: The `*` key added for MIN. Without it an unbounded arity resolves no template.

mutations.name: kinds-unify-loosely
mutations.was: Found by the fuzz lane. IF(TRUE, TRUE, "A-1") is "TRUE" in SEL and 1 on the server.

mutations.name: bool-compared-to-a-number
mutations.was: Found by the fuzz lane. CAST(0 AS CHAR) and CAST(FALSE AS CHAR) are both '0'.

mutations.name: bool-compared-to-a-number-in-a-list
mutations.was: The same guard on the IN path. inOperator and binary() lower different operators, and the mutation runner found only one of the two was pinned.

mutations.name: regex-dotall-dropped
mutations.was: M1. Dotall is permanently on in SEL and off by default in the server.

mutations.name: regex-flag-by-count
mutations.was: Code review. Choosing the case-insensitive template by argument count made RMATCH(p, s, "") match case-insensitively.
